_note: Dan plate layout, in pixels of the plate's textures. frame_count: how many back_{i} / plates_{i} textures there are (a dan tick beyond it wraps). The title is drawn vertically, at most title_max_height tall, offset from the plate's centre.

rainbow._note: the rainbow plate: cycles hue cycles along the plate's diagonal, stops colour stops per gradient map, saturation 0 to 1 (a little pastel)

glitter._note: the sparkles over a rainbow plate's frame: size is their scale, max how many at once per box, blend the blend mode, opacity 0 to 1. boxes are the plate's frame (shared by frames 0-4) as [x, y, w, h] from its top-left: top roller, bottom roller, left post, right post.
